segments.zh: 好吧，这种连接可能对您的需求来说有点太慢了。

segments.en: I suggest you get the premium package for $50 a month, which includes a connection speed of 2 megabytes.
segments.zh: 我建议您以每月 50 美元的价格购买高级套餐，其中包括 2 兆字节的连接速度。

segments.en: That way, you can play games online without any lag.
segments.zh: 这样，您可以毫无延迟地在线玩游戏。

segments.en: This package also includes a wireless router and a personal firewall, absolutely free.
segments.zh: 此套餐还包括一个无线路由器和一个完全免费的个人防火墙。

segments.en: Do I have to pay an installation fee?
Lucky for you, this month we aren't charging our normal installation fee.
segments.zh: 幸运的是，本月我们不收取正常的安装费。

segments.en: You are saving yourself $100 right there.
segments.zh: 你在那里节省了 100 美元。

segments.en: And we'll throw in this pen drive.
segments.zh: 我们还会赠送这个 U 盘。

segments.en: Awesome!
So the internet is a big deal nowadays and now you can do so much on it.
segments.zh: 所以现在互联网很重要，现在你可以在它上面做很多事情。

segments.en: Not only navigate websites anymore, but watch movies, download applications, photos, Facebook, all this type of things now you can do on the internet.
segments.zh: 不仅不再浏览网站，还可以在互联网上观看电影、下载应用程序、照片、Facebook 以及所有这些类型的事情。

segments.en: You can even do it from your phone, like when you're in the bathroom or on the train.
segments.zh: 您甚至可以通过手机进行操作，例如在浴室或火车上。

segments.en: I mean, it's scary.
We're always connected.
Right.
So it's interesting.
You're always connected.
You're always online with people.
And it's actually very noticeable when you maybe live somewhere else.
segments.zh: 当您可能住在其他地方时，它实际上非常明显。

segments.en: Before you used to have to write letters.
segments.zh: 在你过去不得不写信之前。

segments.en: I don't think many people receive handwritten letters anymore.
segments.zh: 我不认为有很多人收到手写的信件。

segments.en: Never.
I'm speaking for myself.
I never receive.
And I don't write them either.
So I guess I'm guilty of it.
segments.zh: 所以我想我对此感到内疚。

segments.en: So now people just send emails.
segments.zh: 所以现在人们只是发送电子邮件。

segments.en: Obviously it's more convenient, but maybe it's a little bit less significant maybe than actually going to the post office or taking the time to write a letter, going to the post office and stuff.
segments.zh: 显然它更方便，但也许它比实际去邮局或花时间写信、去邮局和其他东西的意义要小一点。

segments.en: Well, I don't know.
I mean, there's something nice about having a physical thing you can hold on to, but I wonder if one day we're going to forget how to write.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，有一件你可以坚持的身体上的东西是件好事，但我想知道有一天我们是否会忘记如何写作。

segments.en: You know, like write with a pen.
segments.zh: 你知道，就像用笔写字一样。

segments.en: With a pen and pencil.
Exactly.
We're going to have these little PDAs and these little iPhones and they're going to just, you're going to talk and they're going to take everything down in note form for you.
segments.zh: 我们将拥有这些小 PDA 和这些小 iPhone，它们将只是，您将交谈，他们将以笔记形式为您删除所有内容。

segments.en: Well, now it's kind of happening with the Kindle, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，现在它在 Kindle 上发生了，对吧？

segments.en: Now you can have books on this electronic device that lets you read through them.
segments.zh: 现在，您可以在这个电子设备上拥有书籍，让您阅读它们。

segments.en: You can carry a hundred books with you to the beach.
segments.zh: 您可以随身携带一百本书到海滩。

segments.en: So now you don't even really need physical books, which is good on some level because you know, you're saving trees and space and all that stuff.
segments.zh: 所以现在你甚至不需要实体书，这在某种程度上是好的，因为你知道，你正在节省树木和空间以及所有这些东西。

segments.en: But there's something physical about reading a book.
segments.zh: 但是读书有一些物理意义。

segments.en: You hold it, you flip the pages, you know how many pages you have left.
segments.zh: 你拿着它，你翻页，你知道你还剩下多少页。

segments.en: I don't know.
We'll see.
Maybe I'll be a convert one day, but for now I'm good with paper books.
segments.zh: 也许有一天我会成为一名皈依者，但现在我很擅长纸质书。

segments.en: All right.
So what do you guys think about the internet, about electronic books?
segments.zh: 那么你们对互联网和电子书有什么看法呢？

segments.en: You can also tell us any problems or confusion you have with the things that we talked about today.
segments.zh: 您还可以告诉我们您对我们今天讨论的事情的任何问题或困惑。

segments.en: Hopefully everything is clear, but if not, we are here to answer your questions.
segments.zh: 希望一切都清楚，但如果没有，我们将在这里回答您的问题。

segments.en: We like to do so.
So check out our website, EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，请查看我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: All right.
We'll see you guys there and until next time.
segments.zh: 到时候见，各位；下次再见。

segments.en: Goodbye everyone.
